decision: Require a complete physical gate summary, including on timeout
why: A timeout previously passed without evidence

decision: Package actual executable objects without system/main.c
why: The internal archive is not a complete embedding library; dependency stubs conflict when force-loaded

decision: Remove MAP_JIT only from the TCI bytecode path
why: The real phone rejected the upstream buffer allocation with EPERM

decision: Reject restart and explicitly join the round-robin vCPU
why: Upstream cleanup pauses execution but does not provide reusable initialization or terminate that thread

decision: Preserve the stalled repeat and disable automatic screen sleep during later foreground boots
why: The stalled repeat had no summary; its cause was not established
result: Failure cause remains inconclusive; final foreground run passes

decision: Keep the Android userspace gate incomplete
why: The verified init is Alpine diagnostic userspace, not Android init and vendor services
result: Kernel dependencies pass; Android boot unexecuted
